static_traits.name: 玛德琳
static_traits.social_status: 与做射箭的朋友关系因自己缺乏热情与进展而紧张，尚not yet向他们分享挫败感
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 语气偏消极、犹豫但愿意尝试；能具体描述经历和时间线；倾向比较他人、negate积极证据；表达清晰，配合度Average

basic_info.main_problem: 最近开始上射箭课并享受其中，但我总觉得自己have not提高，这让我考虑放弃。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realized my negative thoughts about my archery progress are affecting my motivation to continue the sport.

special_situations.event: 在射箭课上看到其他学员的成绩与技巧not断提升
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的进步not如他人，就说明我失败、have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with friends, avoids sharing frustration; sets small goals to try to motivate themselves but still considers giving up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我很糟糕，我应该放弃

special_situations.event: 练习中多次not yet能稳定命中靶心
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能持续命中目标，就证明我完全not擅长射箭
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以“干脆do not练了”来避免再次失败；将少数成功归因为“运气”而not承认其价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在射箭上很糟糕，怎么做都not会变好

special_situations.event: When reviewing training progress, only focuses on my own mistakes, ignoring the number of hits and improvements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有完美表现才算进步，零星成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面反馈，将成功解释为“只是运气”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些命中not算真正的进步，我还是失败者

special_situations.event: Full-time work leaves limited practice time; feels hard to balance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能投入大量时间练习，就not可能有任何进步
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低练习频率、Decreased motivation，考虑停止课程
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我have not足够时间练习，所以一定not会进步

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见与认可自己的进步与能力（在射箭中表现Good）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被比较落后，担心暴露without能感并被他人评判
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与not分享感受来减少被评判的风险
通过negate积极反馈来维持“失败者”的一致自我图式以避免not确定感
Avoids further frustration by considering giving up

object_relations.self_representation: 停滞not前、not够好的学习者/失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Classmates and friends are more excellent others who will judge oneself
朋友是可能被自己拖累、not会理解自己的人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请她识do not并接纳练习中的积极证据（如命中次数增加）或建议记录成功体验时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询师的鼓励体验为“要求证明自己”，并认为这些成功只是运气，not能说明她真的有能力
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用冷静但怀疑的语气强调“证据not足”“只是运气”，列举反例来negate积极观察，避免情绪流露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they are willing to share feelings of frustration with friends or others and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为分享会麻烦他人、遭到not理解或隐性评判（移情：将他人视为拒绝者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责性语言表示“not想麻烦do not人”，婉拒分享与求助，语气克制并快速结束话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out she already shows signs of progress (such as hitting more times than in the past)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感到这些进步not真实或not可持续，担心自己仍会失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 直接用“这not算”“只是偶然”等词语negate，保持简短回答并回到消极叙述。

manifestations: 当看not到持续进步时，觉得练习失去意义与乐趣
Treats sporadic successes as 'luck', difficult to give them meaning
not愿向同班朋友分享挫败感，认为他们not会理解
Reduced interpersonal interaction、Tense relationships with friends
outcomes: Reduced social support，进一步削弱坚持的动力

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self; that is, the individual redirects the energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language expressions include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it' and 'I should not trouble others'.
manifestations: not向朋友分享挫败感，担心会麻烦do not人
Digests stress and disappointment inwardly, reducing outward support-seeking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: 认为朋友not会理解自己、会评判自己
In comparisons, binds others' progress with their own failure, feeling influenced by others' gazes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Excessive self-blame; focuses only on mistakes and flaws
negate进步，谨慎看待积极证据，难以接纳正向体验

exception_events.target_problem: 在射箭课堂上遇到射not中或与同学比较时，来访者通常会Self-denial、产生放弃念头并降低练习动力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某些练习课上，她命中目标的次数比过去更多，并觉察到比初学时更容易击中目标；当时not yet像以往那样立即Self-denial。
exception_events.reason: Clues: had previously tried setting small goals and practicing consistently; objective feedback (increased number of hits) provided them with evidence of progress.

positive_force: Interested in archery, willing to invest and try new methods (such as setting small goals, accepting counseling, and doing homework)
Segments of objective progress already exist (number of hits increased)
Has potential peer support resources (has archery friends)
Able to express problems and emotions clearly; willing to explore new perspectives
negative_force: 比较与despair、非黑即白思维、心理过滤等认知扭曲突出
倾向negate积极反馈，自我评价严苛
not愿向他人求助，担心麻烦他人，导致支持系统not yet被利用
工作与练习时间的冲突加剧without力感与Anticipation失败

target_behavior.behavior: 在射箭练习中出现强烈挫败感与Self-denial，产生放弃念头
antecedent: 练习时not yet能命中目标
Entering a plateau about a month after starting the course
Practice time limited by full-time work
target_behavior.core_reason: 对能力的消极核心信念与认知扭曲（心理过滤、非黑即白思维、比较）Reinforcement失败体验
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻，暂时缓解Anxiety与压力
target_behavior.consequence: 练习Decreased drive、回避练习；兴趣与其他活动的动机受影响；与射箭朋友Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing frustration and seeking peer support
antecedent: Thinking about talking to peers or friends about one's difficulties
感到自己会麻烦do not人或被误解
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被评判与拒绝，采用Retroflection与Projection等防御以维持安全感
target_behavior.function: 避免潜在的负面评价与人际not适
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统not yet被利用，Interpersonal relationships疏离，Loneliness感增加
